newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Form sells property venture stake.
newsitem.headline: Top Form sells property venture stake.

text.p: Underwear maker Top Form International Ltd has agreed to sell its stake in a property joint venture in China to a subsidiary of New World Development Co Ltd for about HK$36 million.
Top Form said it would sell Max Charm Investment Ltd to New World for a total of about HK$36 million.
Max Charm owns 17.5 percent interest in a joint venture Dalian New World Plaza International Co Ltd in China.

The joint venture is also 35 percent held by New World Development (China) Ltd, 17.5 percent by Prestige (China) Ltd which is a unit of Prestige Properties Holdings Ltd, and 30 percent by Chinese partner Dalian Supply and Sell Co-op Unite Agency.
On completion of the deal, New World's take in the venture will be raised to 52.5 percent, it said.
The joint venture is to develop a site consisting of the construction of a commercial complex of offices, shopping arcades and residential apartments, for which the foundations have been laid.
Top Form said the sale would enable the company to reduce its liabilities on non-income generating business.

It said it would use the proceeds to cut the company's indebtedness, and to enable it to refocus its activities on its profitable core operations which consist of the manufacturing of ladies intimate apparel.
